issues.description: Visibility mismatch for Animal.messageOnFeed(): The UML/problem statement specifies this method as public (+ messageOnFeed():String), but the solution defines it as `protected abstract String messageOnFeed();`. This contradicts the required signature and can confuse students about the expected access level.
issues.suggestedFix: Align all artifacts to the same visibility. Prefer updating the solution (and expected student implementation/tests) to `public abstract String messageOnFeed();` in Animal to match the UML/problem statement, or explicitly change the UML/task text to `protected` if that is intended.
